name: ROLI Lightpad Block M
notice: The loaded Dashboard app determines note grid, channel range and CC assignments; no fixed pad mapping is assumed. Baseline profile: parameter CC mappings and USB port names have not been verified; select this profile manually for your MIDI port. Panel art is a schematic, not a scale hardware diagram. For per-note expression, configure matching MPE zones and pitch-bend ranges in the controller and destination; the single-channel notes GUI does not reproduce MPE gestures.
